source: Kingdom Studios public repos and https://devs.defikingdoms.com

realms.serendale: Kaia (formerly Klaytn). Power token JADE. Early Harmony contracts live in contracts/.
realms.crystalvale: DFK Chain, an Avalanche L1. Power token CRYSTAL. Gas is JEWEL.

areas.name: The Marketplace
areas.does: Swap tokens on the UniswapV2 DEX, mint LP seeds, and sell quest items to the vendor for gold.

areas.name: The Gardens
areas.does: Stake LP seeds in MasterGardener pools to earn power-token emissions. Heroes can run gardening quests on the same pools.

areas.name: The Tavern
areas.does: Hero catalog, sale auctions, rentals for summoning, and sending a hero to another profile.

areas.name: The Bank
areas.does: Lock JEWEL for xJEWEL and claim vested rewards through the Banker.

areas.name: The Alchemist
areas.does: Craft potions and consumables from profession reagents.

areas.name: Meditation Circle
areas.does: Spend runes to level a hero once their experience bar is full.

areas.name: The Colosseum
areas.does: PVP combat on Metis. Local matches stand in until those contracts are called.

harmonyAddresses.note: Serendale 1.0 addresses published in KingdomStudiosIO/contracts README. Later realms use different addresses listed on devs.defikingdoms.com.
